question: I returned a dress last week and it was approved. When will the money reach my card?
answer: Since your refund is approved, the money goes back to the card you paid with, which takes 7 to 10 working days depending on your card's bank. If it hasn't arrived after that, contact support with your order number and the case will be escalated to the payments team within 24 hours.

question: मैले क्यास अन डेलिभरीमा तिरेको थिएँ, रिफन्ड कसरी र कति दिनमा पाइन्छ?
answer: क्यास अन डेलिभरीमा तिर्नुभएको भए, रिफन्ड स्वीकृत भएपछि एपमा आफ्नो खाता विवरण दिनुहोस्; विवरण दिएको ५ कार्य दिनभित्र पैसा तपाईंको वालेट वा बैंक खातामा फिर्ता गरिन्छ।

question: wallet bata tireko order cancel gare, paisa kati din ma firta aaucha?
answer: Order ship hunu agi (Placed, Confirmed wa Packed huda) My Orders bata cancel garna sakinchha, ra cancel garda kunai shulka lagdaina. Prepaid order ko refund normal refund timeline anusar aauchha, tara wallet bata tireko cancelled order ko refund kati din ma aauchha bhanne kura yo jankari ma lekhieko chhaina. (Wallet ma 24 ghanta bhitra firta hune niyam chai checkout ma payment fail bhaera paisa katiyeko awastha ko lagi matra ho.)

question: refund approve bhayo bhanyo tara 2 hapta bhayo card ma aayena, aba k garne?
answer: Card bata tireko bhaye refund card ko bank anusar 7 dekhi 10 working days ma aauchha. Tyo awadhi pachhi pani paisa naaye order number sahit support lai samparka garnuhos; 24 ghanta bhitra case payment team ma pathaincha.

question: जुत्ता साइज मिलेन, साट्न पाइन्छ? कति दिनभित्र?
answer: हो, साइज साट्न एउटा अर्डरमा एक पटक पाइन्छ, तर स्टकमा भए मात्र। डेलिभरी भएको ७ दिनभित्र प्रयोग नगरेको, ट्याग र सक्कली प्याकेजिङसहितको सामान फिर्ता गर्न सकिन्छ; साट्नका लागि छुट्टै समयसीमा लेखिएको छैन। यदि अर्डर गरेभन्दा फरक साइज आएको हो भने डेलिभरी भएको ४८ घण्टाभित्र फोटो र अर्डर नम्बरसहित जानकारी दिनुहोस्।

question: How many days do I have to send back a shirt I don't like?
answer: You can return the shirt within 7 days of delivery, as long as it is unused and still has its tags and original packaging. Start the return from My Orders.

question: अर्डर पठाइसकेको रहेछ, अब क्यान्सिल गर्न मिल्छ?
answer: अर्डर पठाइसकेपछि रद्द गर्न मिल्दैन। तर डेलिभरीको बेला तपाईं पार्सल नलिन सक्नुहुन्छ, वा लिएर फिर्ताको अनुरोध गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ। अग्रिम भुक्तानी गरिएको अर्डर भए रिफन्ड सामान्य रिफन्ड समयअनुसार आउँछ, क्यास अन डेलिभरीमा रिफन्ड चाहिँदैन।

question: galti le order gare, kasari cancel garne?
answer: Order ship hunu aghi samma, arthat status Placed, Confirmed wa Packed hunjel, My Orders bata cancel garna saknuhunchha, ra cancel garda kunai shulka lagdaina. Order ship bhaisakepachhi cancel garna mildaina; tyo bela delivery ma parcel nalina wa lier return request garna saknuhunchha. Prepaid order ko refund normal refund samaya anusar aauchha, Cash on Delivery order ma refund chahindaina.

question: How long does delivery take outside Kathmandu?
answer: Outside Kathmandu valley, delivery to other cities usually takes 3 to 7 working days, and remote areas can take up to 10 working days. The delivery charge outside the valley is shown at checkout, and you can track your parcel on the order page.

question: उपत्यकाभित्र डेलिभरी चार्ज कति लाग्छ?
answer: काठमाडौं उपत्यकाभित्र डेलिभरी शुल्क रु १०० लाग्छ, तर रु २,००० भन्दा माथिको अर्डरमा डेलिभरी निःशुल्क हुन्छ। उपत्यकाभित्र सामान्यतया १ देखि ३ कार्य दिनमा डेलिभरी हुन्छ।

question: 2500 ko order ma delivery free huncha ki nai?
answer: Kathmandu upatyaka bhitra NPR 2,000 bhanda mathiko order ma delivery free huncha, tyasaile 2500 ko order ma upatyaka bhitra delivery free huncha. Upatyaka bahira bhane delivery charge checkout ma dekhaincha.

question: Tracking says delivered but I never got the parcel. What now?
answer: Report it within 48 hours of the delivered status. We will check the courier's proof of delivery, and if the parcel cannot be found, we will send the order again or give you a full refund, whichever you choose.

question: भनिएको मिति नाघेको ३ दिन भयो, पार्सल अझै आएन।
answer: प्रतिज्ञा गरिएको अन्तिम मितिभन्दा २ दिन ढिलोसम्म पनि अर्डर नआएकाले अब अर्डर पेजबाट जानकारी दिनुहोस्। हामी कुरियरसँग छानबिन सुरु गरी ४८ घण्टाभित्र जवाफ दिनेछौं।

question: delivered dekhaucha tara malai kei aayena, kati din bhitra report garnu parcha?
answer: Tracking ma delivered dekhayera pani parcel aayena bhane delivered dekhaeko 48 ghanta bhitra order page bata report garnuhos. Hami courier ko delivery proof check garchhau, ra parcel bhetiyena bhane tapai ko rojai anusar pheri pathaincha wa purai paisa phirta garincha.

question: If my lost parcel can't be found, do I get my money back?
answer: Yes. If tracking shows delivered but you didn't receive it, report it within 48 hours of the delivered status; if the parcel cannot be found, we either send the order again or give a full refund, whichever you choose. If the order simply hasn't arrived 2 days after the latest promised date, report it from the order page and we'll investigate with the courier and reply within 48 hours.

question: The mixer grinder arrived with a cracked jar. How do I get a replacement?
answer: Report the damaged item within 48 hours of delivery, attaching photos of the item and the package along with your order number. We will replace it at no cost (or refund it if a replacement is not in stock), and pickup of the damaged item is free, so keep it until the case is closed.

question: galat saman aayo, photo pathaunu parcha? kati ghanta bhitra?
answer: Ho, galat saman aayo bhane delivery bhayeko 48 ghanta bhitra jankari dinuhos ra saman ra packet ko photo sanga order number pathaunuhos. Hami nihshulka arko saman pathaunchhaun, stock ma nabhaye paisa phirta garchhaun; case natungiye samma saman naphalnuhos.

question: bigreko saman firta lina aauda paisa lagcha?
answer: Lagdaina. Galat wa bigreko saman laijana kunai shulka lagdaina; delivery bhayeko 48 ghantabhitra janakari dinuhos, ra case natungiyesamma saman nafalnuhos.

question: Payment failed at checkout but my bank balance went down. Was the order placed?
answer: No, the order was not placed: when a payment fails at checkout but money is deducted, no order is created. The amount is reversed automatically to the account it came from, within 24 hours for wallet payments and within 5 working days for cards and bank transfers. Place the order again only if you still want the item, and if the money is not back after 5 working days, send us the transaction ID from your bank or wallet statement.

question: चेकआउटमा एरर आयो तर वालेटबाट पैसा काटियो, कहिले फिर्ता आउँछ?
answer: चेकआउटमा भुक्तानी फेल भएर पैसा काटिएमा अर्डर बन्दैन, र वालेटबाट काटिएको रकम २४ घण्टाभित्र आफैं सोही खातामा फिर्ता हुन्छ। त्यो समयभित्र हामीलाई सम्पर्क गर्नु पर्दैन; सामान अझै चाहिए मात्र फेरि अर्डर गर्नुहोस्।

question: card bata payment garda fail bhayo tara paisa katyo, 5 din bhaisakyo
answer: Payment fail bhaye pani paisa katiyo bhane order bandaina, ra card ko paisa 5 working days bhitra aafai firta hunchha. 5 working days pachhi pani paisa aayena bhane bank statement bata transaction ID hamilai pathaunuhos. Saman ajhai chahinchha bhane matra pheri order garnuhos.

question: Is there an extra charge for cash on delivery?
answer: No, cash on delivery has no extra fee for orders up to NPR 25,000. You can pay the rider in cash or by scanning the rider's QR code; please keep the exact amount ready, as riders may not carry change.

question: rider lai QR scan garera tirna milcha?
answer: Milcha, cash on delivery ma rider lai nagad wa rider ko QR code scan garera tirna sakinchha, kunai thap shulka lagdaina. Tara yo NPR 25,000 samma ko order ma matra painchha; gift card, prepaid only lekhiyeka kehi seller ra NPR 25,000 bhanda mathi ko order ma COD suvidha chhaina.

question: My headphones stopped working after 3 months. Who handles the warranty?
answer: After 3 months, warranty claims go to the brand's service centre, not to us; the warranty period is the manufacturer's warranty shown on the product page, usually 1 year. Download the invoice from your order page and take it with you. Note that physical damage and liquid damage are not covered.

question: नयाँ फोन आउँदै अन भएन, के साटिदिनुहुन्छ?
answer: हजुर, खराब अवस्थामा आएको सामानका लागि डेलिभरी भएको ४८ घण्टाभित्र जानकारी दिनुहोस् र सामान, प्याकेटको फोटो तथा अर्डर नम्बर पठाउनुहोस्। हामी निःशुल्क अर्को सामान पठाउँछौं, स्टकमा नभए पैसा फिर्ता गर्छौं। केस नटुङ्गिएसम्म फोन नफाल्नुहोस्।

question: phone ma pani paseko cha, warranty ma parcha?
answer: Pardaina. Phone ma pani paseko kshati warranty ma pardaina, tyasaile brand ko service centre bata warranty dabi garna mildaina.

question: My phone recharge failed but the wallet deducted NPR 200.
answer: The NPR 200 from a failed recharge is reversed to your wallet automatically within 24 hours. If the top-up shows Pending, wait up to 2 hours before trying again so you are not charged twice. If the money has not come back after 24 hours, raise a ticket from the transaction's page, which already carries the transaction ID.

question: रिचार्ज Pending देखायो, फेरि गरूँ कि पर्खूँ?
answer: फेरि तुरुन्तै नगर्नुहोस्; दुई पटक पैसा नकाटियोस् भनेर फेरि प्रयास गर्नुअघि बढीमा २ घण्टा पर्खनुहोस्। रिचार्ज फेल भएर पैसा काटिएको भए २४ घण्टाभित्र आफैं वालेटमा फिर्ता हुन्छ, नआए त्यो ट्रान्ज्याक्सनको पेजबाट टिकट खोल्नुहोस्।

question: data pack kineko fail bhayo, paisa kati bela firta aaucha?
answer: Data pack top-up fail bhaera pani wallet bata paisa katiyo bhane 24 ghanta bhitra aafai wallet ma firta aaucha. Top-up Pending dekhayo bhane dui patak nakatiyos bhanera pheri try garnu aghi badhima 2 ghanta parkhanuhos. 24 ghanta pachi pani paisa firta naaaye tyo transaction ko page bata ticket kholnuhos; tyasma transaction ID aafai hunchha.

question: I paid my electricity bill, the wallet says failed but money is gone.
answer: If a bill payment fails but your wallet is debited, the amount is reversed within 3 working days. The payment may still have reached the utility even though it shows Failed, so check your bill status after a day before paying again. Keep the receipt from the transaction page in case the utility asks for it.

question: khanepani ko bill tireko fail dekhayo, paisa kahile firta huncha?
answer: Bill bhuktani fail bhaera pani wallet bata paisa katiyeko chha bhane 3 karya din bhitra rakam firta hunchha. Kahilekahin wallet ma Failed dekhaye pani bhuktani sewa pradayak samma pugeko hunchha, tyasaile pheri tirnu aghi ek din pachhi bill ko sthiti hernuhos. Sewa pradayak le mage dekhauna transaction page ko rasid rakhnuhos.

question: I sent money to my brother an hour ago and he still hasn't got it.
answer: Since it has been over 30 minutes, first check your brother's number in your transaction history. If the number is correct, report the transfer from its transaction page, and it will be traced within 2 working days. If the transfer stays in Pending for 72 hours, it is reversed to your wallet automatically.

question: transfer pending ma atkiyo 3 din bhayo, paisa ke huncha?
answer: Pending ma 72 ghanta samma atkiyeko transfer aafai tapaiko wallet ma firta huncha. 3 din bhaisakeko le paisa firta aayo ki chhaina wallet ma herna sakincha; paisa napugeko bhaye transaction history ma paaunelako number check garera, number sahi bhaye tyo transaction ko page bata jankari dinuhos, hami 2 karya din bhitra patta lagauchhau.
unsupported_statements: Since 3 days have passed, you can check in your wallet whether the money has been returned (the excerpt says nothing about checking the wallet for a refund, and 3 days = 72 hours is not addressed)

The advice to check the number only after the money has not arrived, framed relative to the 3-day pending case, is not in the excerpt, which ties the number check to money not arriving within 30 minutes

question: How long is a wallet transfer supposed to take?
answer: Wallet-to-wallet transfers are normally instant. If the recipient hasn't received the money within 30 minutes, check the recipient's number in your transaction history, and if it's correct, report the transfer from its transaction page; it will be traced within 2 working days.

question: I typed one digit wrong and sent 5000 to a stranger. Can you reverse it?
answer: We can't reverse a completed transfer without the recipient's consent, so please report it right away from the transaction page. We will then contact the recipient and ask them to return the money; most cases are settled within 5 working days. If the number isn't registered with the wallet, the money is held for 7 days and then returns to you automatically.

question: गल्तीले अर्कैको नम्बरमा पैसा गयो, फिर्ता पाइन्छ?
answer: पाउनेको सहमतिबिना पूरा भइसकेको ट्रान्सफर फिर्ता गर्न मिल्दैन, त्यसैले तुरुन्तै ट्रान्ज्याक्सन पेजबाट जानकारी दिनुहोस्। हामी पाउनेलाई सम्पर्क गरी पैसा फिर्ता गर्न अनुरोध गर्छौं र धेरैजसो केस ५ कार्य दिनभित्र टुङ्गिन्छन्। नम्बर वालेटमा दर्ता नभएको भए पैसा ७ दिन रोकिन्छ र त्यसपछि आफैं तपाईंलाई फिर्ता आउँछ।

question: galat number ma paisa gayo, tyo number ta wallet ma register nai chaina re
answer: Tyo number wallet ma register chaina bhane, paisa 7 din samma hold garincha ani tespachi aafai tapai ko wallet ma farkancha. Aba dekhi transfer confirm garnu aghi dekhaieko naam check garnuhos.

question: मेरो केवाईसी किन अस्वीकृत भयो होला?
answer: केवाईसी अस्वीकृत हुने सामान्य कारणहरू कागजातको फोटो धमिलो वा काटिएको हुनु, नाम वालेट खातासँग नमिल्नु, र कागजातको म्याद सकिनु हुन्। यी कुरा सच्याएर तुरुन्तै फेरि पेस गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ। तपाईंको केवाईसी ठ्याक्कै कुन कारणले अस्वीकृत भयो भन्ने जानकारी यहाँ उपलब्ध छैन।

question: केवाईसी नगरेको वालेटबाट साथीलाई पैसा पठाउन मिल्छ?
answer: केवाईसी स्वीकृत नभएसम्म वालेटमा प्रमाणित नभएको खाताको कम सीमा लागू हुन्छ, तर त्यो सीमा कति हो र साथीलाई पठाउन मिल्छ कि मिल्दैन भन्ने कुरा यहाँ स्पष्ट लेखिएको छैन। पूरा सुविधाका लागि नागरिकता, राहदानी वा राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र, हालको फोटो र ठेगाना अपलोड गरेर केवाईसी गर्नुहोस्; यो २ कार्य दिनभित्र जाँचिन्छ।

question: पिन बिर्सें, कसरी नयाँ राख्ने?
answer: लगइन स्क्रिनमा Forgot PIN छान्नुहोस् र ओटीपी तथा जन्म मितिको मद्दतले नयाँ पिन राख्नुहोस्। ध्यान दिनुहोस्, ५ पटक गलत पिन हालेमा खाता ३० मिनेटका लागि लक हुन्छ, र हामी फोन वा म्यासेजबाट कहिल्यै पिन वा ओटीपी माग्दैनौं।

question: I loaded 10,000 from my bank, the bank deducted it but my wallet balance didn't change.
answer: This kind of load is usually settled automatically within 2 hours. If it isn't, your bank will reverse the 10,000 to your account within 3 to 5 working days. Keep the bank's reference number, since it will be needed if you raise a ticket.

question: बैंकबाट लोड गरेको पैसा वालेटमा आएन, कहिले मिल्छ?
answer: बैंक खाताबाट पैसा काटिए पनि वालेटमा ब्यालेन्स नबढेमा सामान्यतया २ घण्टाभित्र आफैं मिल्छ। नमिले बैंकले ३ देखि ५ कार्य दिनभित्र रकम तपाईंको खातामा फिर्ता गर्छ। टिकट खोल्नुपरे चाहिने भएकाले बैंकको रेफरेन्स नम्बर राख्नुहोस्।

question: Is there a fee for moving wallet money to my bank account?
answer: The first 3 transfers from your wallet to a bank account each month are free. After that, each transfer costs NPR 10.

question: There's a payment in my history that I didn't make. What should I do first?
answer: First, change your PIN at once and block the wallet from Profile > Block wallet, or call the 24-hour helpline. Then report the transaction within 7 days so it can be investigated; investigations take up to 10 working days. Remember, the wallet never asks for your PIN, OTP or password.

question: कसैले फोन गरेर ओटीपी माग्यो, वालेटको मान्छे हो?
answer: होइन, वालेटले फोन वा म्यासेजबाट कहिल्यै पिन वा ओटीपी माग्दैन, त्यसैले ओटीपी माग्ने व्यक्ति वालेटको मान्छे होइन। ओटीपी नदिनुहोस्; आफूले नगरेको कारोबार देखिएमा तुरुन्तै पिन फेर्नुहोस् र Profile > Block wallet बाट वालेट ब्लक गर्नुहोस्, वा २४ घण्टे हेल्पलाइनमा फोन गर्नुहोस्।

question: maile nagareko transaction dekhiyo, wallet kasari block garne?
answer: Aafule nagareko transaction dekhiyo bhane turuntai PIN pherera Profile > Block wallet bata wallet block garnuhos, wa 24 ghante helpline ma phone garnuhos. Chhanbin garna sakiyos bhanera 7 din bhitra transaction ko jankari dinuhos; chhanbin ma badhima 10 karya din lagchha. Hami kahilyai PIN, OTP wa password magdainau.

question: क्यासब्याकको पैसा बैंकमा पठाउन मिल्छ?
answer: मिल्दैन, क्यासब्याकको रकम बैंक खातामा पठाउन सकिँदैन।

question: refund bhayeko payment ko cashback pani paincha?
answer: Paindaina. Refund wa reverse bhayeko karobar ma cashback dina mildaina, ra cashback aaisakepachhi payment refund bhayo bhane tyo cashback firta liincha.

question: I lost my debit card at the bus park. How do I block it?
answer: Block the card right away in mobile banking under Cards > Block card, or call the 24-hour helpline; the block takes effect immediately. Note that a card blocked as lost cannot be unblocked, so request a replacement card afterwards (NPR 500, ready at your chosen branch within 5 working days).

question: मेरो डेबिट कार्ड हरायो, ब्लक गरिदिनुस्

question: How much does a new debit card cost?
answer: A replacement debit card costs NPR 500, which is charged to your account. You can request it in mobile banking or at any branch.

question: नयाँ कार्ड बन्न कति दिन लाग्छ?
answer: नयाँ कार्ड तपाईंले छानेको शाखामा ५ कार्य दिनभित्र लिन तयार हुन्छ; लिन जाँदा परिचयपत्र लिएर जानुहोस्। नयाँ कार्ड मोबाइल बैंकिङ वा जुनसुकै शाखाबाट माग्न सकिन्छ र शुल्क रु ५०० खाताबाट काटिन्छ।

question: naya card ko pin kasari rakhne?
answer: Naya card ko PIN mobile banking ko Cards > Set PIN bata rakhna sakincha.

question: The ATM didn't give me cash but my account was debited.
answer: The amount will be reversed automatically: within 2 working days if it was our own ATM, or within 7 working days at another bank's ATM. If the money is not back by then, file a dispute in mobile banking or at a branch with the date, time and location of the ATM; disputes are resolved within 15 working days.

question: I forgot my mobile banking password.
answer: You can reset your password yourself in the app using your account number and an OTP sent to your registered mobile number. Be careful: after 3 wrong password attempts, mobile banking is blocked for 24 hours. If your registered mobile number has changed, update it at a branch first.

question: नयाँ फोनमा मोबाइल बैंकिङ खोल्न मिलेन।
answer: फोन फेर्दा नयाँ डिभाइसलाई ओटीपीसहित फेरि दर्ता गर्नुपर्छ। तपाईंको दर्ता भएको मोबाइल नम्बर पनि फेरिएको छ भने पहिले शाखामा गएर नम्बर अपडेट गर्नुहोस्। ३ पटक गलत पासवर्ड हालेमा मोबाइल बैंकिङ २४ घण्टाका लागि बन्द हुने भएकाले पासवर्ड बिर्सनुभएको छ भने खाता नम्बर र ओटीपीको मद्दतले नयाँ पासवर्ड राख्नुहोस्।

question: My registered mobile number changed. How do I log in to mobile banking now?
answer: Since your registered mobile number has changed, first visit a branch to update it. After that, you can reset your password in the app using your account number and an OTP sent to your registered mobile number, and if you're using a new phone, register the new device again with an OTP.

question: How much can I send to another bank per day through mobile banking?
answer: Through mobile banking you can send up to NPR 200,000 per day to other banks. Transfers to other banks made after 5 pm or on a public holiday settle on the next working day, and to raise your limit for a one-off payment, visit a branch.

question: My transfer to another bank shows successful but my friend hasn't received it.
answer: The receiving bank normally credits a successful transfer within 1 working day. If your friend's bank cannot credit it (for example, if the account number or name does not match), the money will return to your account within 3 working days. Share the transfer's reference number with your friend so their bank can trace it.

question: अर्को बैंकमा पठाएँ, खाता नम्बर गलत रहेछ, पैसा फिर्ता आउँछ?
answer: हजुर, खाता नम्बर वा नाम नमिलेर पाउने बैंकले जम्मा गर्न नसकेमा रकम ३ कार्य दिनभित्र तपाईंको खातामा फिर्ता आउँछ।

question: successful dekhayo tara paune ko khata ma paisa pugena
answer: Tapai le arko bank ma pathayeko paisa Successful dekhaye pani paune le napayeko bhaye, paune bank le samanyataya 1 karya din bhitra khata ma jamma garchha. Khata number wa naam namilera jamma garna nasake, rakam 3 karya din bhitra tapai ko khata ma firta aauchha. Paune ko bank le khoji garna sakos bhanera transfer ko reference number paune lai dinuhos.

question: The bank says my KYC has expired. Can I still withdraw money?
answer: Until your KYC is updated, withdrawals and transfers from your account may be restricted, though deposits still work. To restore full access, update your KYC at any branch or upload your documents in mobile banking under Profile > Update KYC; updates are processed within 3 working days.

question: केवाईसी अपडेट गर्न शाखामै जानुपर्छ कि एपबाट मिल्छ?
answer: शाखामै जानुपर्दैन; केवाईसी जुनसुकै शाखामा गएर वा मोबाइल बैंकिङको Profile > Update KYC मा कागजात अपलोड गरेर अपडेट गर्न सकिन्छ। अपडेट ३ कार्य दिनभित्र हुन्छ।

question: citizenship ko photo fereko, kyc update kati din ma huncha?
answer: Citizenship jasto parichaya kagajat ko myad sakiyema wa bibaran pheriyema KYC update garnu parchha. Kunai pani shakha ma gaera, wa mobile banking ko Profile > Update KYC ma kagajat upload garera update garna sakinchha. Update 3 karya din bhitra hunchha.

question: ६ महिनाको स्टेटमेन्ट कसरी निकाल्ने?
answer: ६ महिनाको स्टेटमेन्ट पछिल्लो १२ महिनाभित्र पर्ने भएकाले मोबाइल बैंकिङबाट निःशुल्क पीडीएफमा डाउनलोड गर्न सकिन्छ। तर भिसाजस्ता कामका लागि छाप लागेको स्टेटमेन्ट चाहिए शाखामा माग्नुहोस्; यसको शुल्क रु १०० हो र सोही दिन तयार हुन्छ।

question: statement ko lagi kati paisa lagcha?
answer: Pachhillo 12 mahinako statement mobile banking bata PDF ma nihshulka download garna sakincha. Purano avadhiko wa chhap lageko (jastai visa ko lagi) statement chahiye shakha ma magnuhos; chhap lageko statement ko shulka Rs 100 ho ra sohi din tayar huncha.

question: Do I need to block my card before disputing a transaction?
answer: Yes. If your statement shows a transaction you did not make, block the card first, then report the transaction within 7 days in mobile banking or at a branch. You can block it in mobile banking under Cards > Block card, or call the 24-hour helpline.

question: Top-up shows pending. Should I try again right away?
answer: No. If the top-up shows Pending, wait up to 2 hours before trying again so you are not charged twice. If it fails and money was deducted, it is reversed to your wallet automatically within 24 hours; if not, raise a ticket from the transaction's page.

question: How long do card refunds take?
answer: Once your refund is approved, it goes back to the card you paid with and takes 7 to 10 working days, depending on your card's bank. If the money hasn't arrived after that, contact support with your order number.

question: हाम्रै बैंकको एटीएमले पैसा दिएन, कति दिनमा फिर्ता हुन्छ?
answer: हाम्रै एटीएमले खाताबाट पैसा काटे पनि नगद नदिएमा रकम २ कार्य दिनभित्र आफैं फिर्ता हुन्छ। त्यसबेलासम्म पनि नआए एटीएमको मिति, समय र स्थानसहित मोबाइल बैंकिङ वा शाखाबाट उजुरी दिनुहोस्; उजुरी १५ कार्य दिनभित्र टुङ्गिन्छ।

question: प्रमाणित वालेटबाट महिनामा कति पैसा पठाउन सकिन्छ?
answer: प्रमाणित वालेटबाट महिनामा रु ५,००,००० सम्म कारोबार गर्न सकिन्छ; यसमा दिनमा रु १,००,००० र एउटा कारोबारमा बढीमा रु ५०,००० को सीमा पनि लाग्छ। आफ्नो आजको बाँकी सीमा Profile > Limits मा हेर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।

question: kathmandu ma aaja pani parcha?
